title: Hydration Myths: Do You Need 8 Glasses?

scenes.text: The 8-glasses-a-day rule is a common belief.
scenes.label: MYTH: 8 glasses of water daily.

scenes.text: Water needs vary based on factors like age, activity level, and climate; listen to your body's thirst cues.
scenes.label: TRUTH: Needs vary significantly.

scenes.text: Hydrate based on your lifestyle and thirst.
scenes.label: TAKEAWAY: Listen to your body!
scenes.query: Hydration Myths: Do You Need 8 Glasses?

scenes.text: Follow for your daily dose of vitality.

description: Do you really need eight glasses of water every day? Find out the truth behind hydration needs and listen to your body. Follow for more insights!
